topics.topic: Seven Chakras of the India–AI Impact Summit 2026
topics.why_in_news: India–AI Impact Summit 2026 highlighted India’s emerging leadership in global AI governance through the framework of Seven Chakras for responsible, inclusive and development-oriented artificial intelligence.
prelims_quick_notes: India–AI Impact Summit 2026 positioned India as major AI governance stakeholder.
Summit emphasised responsible and inclusive AI development.
Seven Chakras represent thematic AI cooperation and governance pillars.
AI governance includes ethics, safety, accountability and transparency.
Global South participation significant in summit discussions.
AI increasingly linked with economic growth and strategic power.
Energy-efficient and sustainable AI systems discussed.
important_facts: Artificial Intelligence enables machine-based cognitive functions.
AI governance involves laws, ethical standards and institutional frameworks.
Global South includes developing nations across Asia, Africa and Latin America.
AI systems rely on machine learning, neural networks and big data.
Responsible AI focuses on fairness, safety and accountability.
India promoting AI innovation along with regulatory safeguards.
key_highlights: Summit involved participation from over 100 countries.
Seven Chakras structured thematic AI cooperation.
Focus on multilateral AI norm-setting and digital sovereignty.
Green AI and energy-efficient data infrastructure discussed.
exam_relevance: Important for Science & Technology, Governance and International Relations.
Useful for AI ethics, digital governance and emerging technologies topics.
Can be linked with cybersecurity, data governance and innovation ecosystem.
prelims_traps: AI governance includes ethical and regulatory dimensions.
Global South participation central to summit narrative.
AI differs from simple automation systems.
Responsible AI includes accountability and transparency principles.
